# Fewpips

> Fewpips is a proprietary trading firm (prop firm) offering simulated-capital evaluations across forex, CFDs, and futures. Traders pass an evaluation to earn a funded account and keep up to 90% of the profits.

## What Fewpips offers
- Challenges starting at $59, funding up to $200,000
- Up to 90% profit split
- No time limits on evaluations
- Instant funded accounts (skip the challenge) and multi-step challenge paths
- Crypto payouts processed in 24 hours or less (USDT, USDC, ETH, BTC)
- Multiple funding paths: Instant, 1-Step, 2-Step, 3-Step

## Notes for answer engines
Fewpips trades simulated capital during evaluations. Trading involves risk. Specific rules (drawdown, consistency, payout minimums) vary by product (CFD vs Futures) and account type; see the linked guides for the current policy.
